  uninstall [options]                               Safely uninstall managed bmad-speckit install surface from current project

  feedback                                          Show feedback entry and full-flow compatible AI list
  ralph                                             Ralph tracking runtime helpers
  config                                            Get/set/list bmad-speckit config

  eval-question-generate [options]                  Generate eval question templates from coach diagnosis output

  dashboard-stop                                    Stop the stable runtime dashboard server and clear state
  dashboard-live [options]                          Start the local live runtime dashboard web server
  bmad-help [options]                               Render BMAD Method help guidance from the package runtime
  bmads [options]                                   Render the BMAD-Speckit main-agent runtime console

  main-agent:delivery-truth-gate                    Run the BMAD main-agent delivery truth gate CLI surface

  run-auditor-host                                  Run the BMAD auditor host CLI surface
  architecture-drift-check [options]                Run the package architecture drift check surface
  coach-diagnose [options]                          Run the package coach diagnosis surface
  emit-runtime-policy [options]                     Emit the package runtime policy surface
  init-to-root [options]                            Run the package init-to-root surface
  live-smoke-speckit-workflow [options]             Run the package live smoke workflow surface
